_note: Baseline patterns handcrafted from niche research. Will be auto-updated by Groq Vision on next pipeline run.

scary.hook_style: Opens mid-action or with a shocking image/sound — no buildup, zero context, forces the viewer to stay to understand what just happened
scary.caption_style: Large white text, black stroke, center-bottom, NO highlight color — horror doesn't use accent colors
scary.visual_style: Dark desaturated footage, heavy grain/noise overlay, red vignette on edges, flicker effect on cuts
scary.pacing_notes: Very fast cuts 2-3s, slow down during the 'reveal', then fast again. Silence then sudden loud audio hit.
scary.what_makes_it_viral: Triggers fear response which locks attention. Ambiguous opening forces viewer to stay for context.

motivation.hook_style: Opens with the end result or transformation — shows success/achievement FIRST, then explains the journey backward
motivation.caption_style: Large bold white text, orange or gold accent on key words, center-screen, slight bounce animation
motivation.visual_style: High contrast, warm color grade, intense athlete or city footage, slow-mo on key moments
motivation.pacing_notes: Builds momentum with each scene — starts at medium pace, accelerates toward climax, ends on a punchy one-liner
motivation.what_makes_it_viral: Triggers dopamine via aspirational imagery. Ending line must be shareable/quotable.

reddit.hook_style: Opens with the most shocking/outrageous sentence from the story — middle or end of the story used as the hook
reddit.caption_style: Medium-large text, Reddit orange accent on names/quotes, white body text, pill background behind text
reddit.visual_style: Reddit card overlay or dark background, minimal visual distraction to focus on the story text
reddit.pacing_notes: Slower than other niches (3-5s/scene) because viewers are reading. Re-hooks every 20s with 'wait for it' or 'but here's the twist'.
reddit.what_makes_it_viral: Comment bait — story must trigger strong opinion (agree/disagree). Viewer imagines themselves in the situation.

rich.hook_style: Opens with a specific shocking number or comparison — '$X per day doing nothing' or 'most people will never know this'
rich.caption_style: Large gold/yellow accent on numbers and key terms, white body, slight glow effect, center-screen
rich.visual_style: Gold color grade, luxury B-roll (watches, cars, mansions), split-screens showing contrast poor vs rich
rich.pacing_notes: Hook must contain a number. Every 3-4 scenes reveal one 'secret'. Final scene = call to action.
rich.what_makes_it_viral: Taps into financial anxiety and desire for shortcuts. Numbers in hooks get 2x more retention.

conspiracy.hook_style: Opens with a forbidden/hidden fact framed as 'they don't want you to know' — creates in-group identity
conspiracy.caption_style: White text, purple accent on key revelations, slightly smaller font to feel more 'documentary', red for warnings
conspiracy.visual_style: Dark desaturated footage, glitch effects on cuts, green matrix-style overlays, shaky cam feel
conspiracy.pacing_notes: Build a 3-part structure: 1) shocking claim, 2) 'evidence', 3) implication. Each part gets a mini re-hook.
conspiracy.what_makes_it_viral: Triggers identity — sharing the video signals to others 'I know things others don't'.

dating.hook_style: Opens with a bold controversial dating opinion or a relatable cringe situation everyone has experienced
dating.caption_style: Pink/red accent on emotional words, white body, center-bottom, clean minimal font
dating.visual_style: Warm bokeh footage, soft color grade, split-screen comparisons, couple silhouettes
dating.pacing_notes: Hook = controversial opinion. Middle = 3 supporting points. End = surprising twist or reversal of the hook.
dating.what_makes_it_viral: Comment bait — strong opinions trigger 'you're wrong' comments which boost algorithm. Relatability = saves.

lifehack.hook_style: Opens with the result/output of the hack — show what it looks like done FIRST, then explain how
lifehack.caption_style: Green accent on the hack/tip, white explanatory text, numbered list format, clean minimal
lifehack.visual_style: Clean bright footage, minimal color grade, close-up shots of hands/objects, split before/after
lifehack.emotional_trigger: usefulness, 'why didn't I know this', time-saving satisfaction
lifehack.pacing_notes: Very fast (2-3s/scene). Each scene = one step. Number the steps on screen. End with 'save this for later'.
lifehack.what_makes_it_viral: Immediate practical value = high save rate. Saves directly boost algorithm ranking.

learn.hook_style: Opens with a counterintuitive or mind-blowing fact stated as absolute truth — no hedging
learn.caption_style: Teal/blue accent on key facts and numbers, white body, large clear font, minimal decoration
learn.visual_style: Clean infographic-style overlays, educational B-roll (science, history, nature), clean color grade
learn.emotional_trigger: curiosity, amazement, desire to share knowledge
learn.pacing_notes: Each scene = one fact. Build from surprising to more surprising. End fact must be the most mind-blowing.
learn.what_makes_it_viral: Share trigger — 'I have to send this to someone'. Counterintuitive facts get 3x shares vs obvious ones.

learn.hook_style: Question hook: 'Did you know...' or 'Why does X happen?' — creates knowledge gap that brain needs to fill
learn.caption_style: Teal accent on question words and key terms, large font, center-screen
learn.visual_style: Science/nature B-roll, clean bright grade, text animations timed to speech
learn.pacing_notes: Open with question, spend 70% building suspense, final 30% = answer + follow-up hook for next video
learn.what_makes_it_viral: Question hooks trigger psychological need for closure. Viewer cannot scroll until they have the answer.

fact.hook_style: Outcome-first: state the most shocking fact immediately, no buildup
fact.caption_style: Blue accent on numbers/superlatives, white body, large font center-bottom
fact.pacing_notes: Fast 3s cuts, each fact more surprising than last
fact.what_makes_it_viral: Chain of escalating surprises keeps viewer watching for the next one
